When I first heard about covid, I first saw it on TV then I saw it on the internet, I heard that it is a disease that causes breathing difficulties. We can prevent it by wearing of mask, keeping distance and by following restrictions that were put in place

The preventive measures that were put in place, first masks, when God created you and gave you the nose for breathing. When a mask was introduced it was blocking the face in that someone you know every day could pass near you, you could recognize them because of the mask. Secondly, it brought laxity in work because we were not working freely. When you are seen carrying two people you will be in trouble because you could be arrested or you can be pursued.
On the other side people die because of curfew, you find that when you go to the hospital after 7pm you find the doctors are not there and you have to wait until the next day.

For me the curfew was put in place whereby people were coming back home in the evening. It was good but on the other side bad too. It was time for the police to come, they were insisting that we keep social distance and yet they were coming with a land cruiser full of policemen. We loved fun so we were going to sit somewhere as a group for them to start a running battle with us. So most of the time there were a lot of accidents involving motorbikes, when someone saw the police they tried to run away only to meet the police coming from that side and that caused many accidents. Secondly the time that was put that people were to back home, we as men you would find that when it reached 7pm we are sited somewhere cooling our minds and at that time is when you are chased and no time to cool your mind and when you go back to the house you are going to transfer your frustrations to them.

The reason why we are the ones doing it and others are not, you know people are different, and on our side we help because we can get how we can go back to the house. We can find a way of putting food on the table, the way we are doing it we are also helping others because not everyone can ride a motorbike. You find others do not know how to ride, so we who know when we do like this those remaining can get help or those working with them can get how to reach where they are going to.
Our role is good as it has helped others with something good. Half of the group started when they were single, but now have families because our role gave them support and are no longer single.

Yes, I can say we are very important in the community because, if someone has malaria and the ambulance cannot reach where he/she is it is only the motorbike that can access that road, it can help in the community because it is important. The sick can get good treatment and get help to take them to the hospital.
Mostly the motorbike riders make the girls happy, when the riders carry them that makes them happy, and we give them some little money.

The reason why the girls feel it is important is because they take advantage of us. You find that a girl can leave home to go Ndori, and expects she will not walk, she knows she is going to get a motorbike rider and knows she looks beautiful the way she is dressed, so even if you see her on the way, you look at the way she is dressed and the face and you are also going to the same direction, you will say let me just escort her because you cannot do that to a boy, but the girl.

Sometimes their mother came to the mines so that she could find a means to survive, and she also followed her mother to the mines and at the end of the day she would have got some money.
